feeds.title: Mandolin Cafe
feeds.description: All about mandolins, including a forum, classifieds, music, chords, news, builders, workshops, and more. Discussions about mandolins, mandolin music and mandolin players.

feeds.title: Mandolin Secrets Blog
feeds.description: Mandolin Secrets is a complete online resource for learning to play the mandolin. It consists of a well-structured, collection of mandolin lessons, inspiring tutorials, and workshops delivered by streaming high-quality, video. Get inspired by new videos, podcast episodes, and blog posts for mandolin and guitar. Tips, lessons, and tutorials are all about music.

feeds.title: Mandoisland
feeds.description: Welcome to www.mandoisland.com. In my blog, I am collecting information about the mandolin, the guitar, and other plucked instruments. I am also writing about my favorite music.

feeds.title: Montana Lutherie Blog
feeds.description: Thirty years of lutherie building Flatiron, Gibson, Weber, and repairing all brands of acoustic instruments: mandolins, mandolas, octaves, and mandocellos. Serving players from the back porch picker to the revered Bill Monroe. Entrust Bruce, and Montana Lutherie, with your mandolin family instrument for customization, add-ons, inspection, and repair.

feeds.title: Tim's Mando Blog
feeds.description: A graduate of the prestigious New England Conservatory of Music and a virtuoso multi-instrumentalist with over twenty-five years of professional performing experience, Tim forges a unique and sophisticated new voice for the mandolin in his work with Mike Marshall's Ger Mandolin Orchestra and through his collaborations with many other luminaries of the acoustic music world.

feeds.title: Mandolin Expert Blog
feeds.description: We Share Practical And Actionable Advice on Mandolins.
